name: Oran Park Hotel
lede: A newly completed hotel in Sydney’s south-west, built of raw materials and natural forms, needed heat that either disappears into the design or becomes part of it. Platinum Electric warms the terraces; Eclipse pendants hang among the courtyard lights.
data: Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric · Eclipse Smart-Heat® Electric pendants

hero.caption: Eclipse pendants in the courtyard. Photograph: Steve Woodburn, as credited by Bromic.

photos.caption: Eclipse heaters on twin drop rods among the pendant lights. Photograph: Steve Woodburn, as credited by Bromic.
High tables under Eclipse heaters in the courtyard. Bromic-published photograph.

beats: Designed by Achiebiosis Architects, the hotel blends natural materials, organic forms and modern hospitality, with semi-enclosed and open-air spaces under high ceilings – among them a double-height central courtyard.
Some areas had no ceiling structure and others little wall space. The heating had to work around lighting, TV screens and fans, either blend in or become a focal point, and leave no cold spots.

With Bromic’s complimentary design service, the team prioritised seated zones and the perimeter. Platinum Electric heaters on wall mounts and pole suspensions warm the terraces and courtyard; Eclipse pendants are custom-integrated with the courtyard’s light fittings.
